rules.regular_season: W-L-T and points from regular-season rows of the nflverse games file only; playoff games never count
rules.division_place: 1 to 4 inside the club's division by win percentage, then the NFL's written tie-break procedure applied to the game scores: head-to-head, division record, common games (at least four), conference record, strength of victory, strength of schedule, the two points rankings, net points in common games, net points in all games; one list for two clubs and for three or more, and when a step leaves two of three or more clubs the procedure restarts for those two; a club's `tiebreak` field names the step that placed it
rules.playoffs: the last playoff round a club played: lost_wild_card, lost_divisional, lost_conference, lost_super_bowl or champion; `bye` is set when its first game was the divisional round
rules.head_coach: the coach with the most regular-season games; a tie goes to the coach whose game came first
rules.club_ids: the NFL's abbreviations today (LAR, LAC, LV, WAS); `label` is what the NFL printed that season (STL, SD, OAK); `arena_index` is the club's index in the game's team table (the order of nfl2k5_champions_history.CLUBS)
rules.footer_ids: category and award ids are the ones of the franchise extension footer (nfl2k5_franchise_extension: RECORD_CATEGORIES, LEADER_CATEGORIES, SEASON_AWARDS); sacks are kept in half sacks (`sacks_half`), the game's own unit; the extra categories points and field_goals have no footer slot
rules.seed: the playoff seed from Wikipedia's final standings tables; it is only set for clubs that made the playoffs and has been checked against the computed playoff field, byes and division winners
rules.awards: every winner of the award that season, in the page's order (`winners[0]` when one name is needed); position codes are the 17 codes of the champions block, HC for a coach; `position_overrides` lists the linebackers and safeties whose side the pages do not name
rules.nfl_records: regular-season records as the pinned Wikipedia record pages list them; ties list every holder; `tied_players` is set where the page names only the latest of a long tie; `checks.records` says what a second source (nflverse, the annual leaders lists) says about each

check_status.exact: the second source gives the same value and holder
check_status.within_stat_correction: nflverse yardage or completions within 0.15 percent (it sums play-by-play, not official figures)
check_status.official_differs: nflverse sums more yards for another player; the annual leaders list agrees with the record
check_status.not_exceeded: the record is older than the data and nothing since 1998 beats it
check_status.partial: a career that began before 1999: nflverse is no more than the record
check_status.exact_with_more: nflverse also lists other players with the tied value
check_status.single_source: only the pinned Wikipedia page speaks (a career before 1999, or tackles, which were never official)

rules.career_leaders: regular-season career top five per category from the pinned Wikipedia leader lists; the tackle list is unofficial (the NFL did not count tackles); `years` is first-last season, `present` while active
rules.hall_of_fame: all inductees through the Class of 2026 as the pinned page lists them; `club` is the club (today's franchise) with the most seasons among the member's stints, null for defunct clubs; `position` is the first listed position as one of the 17 codes, null for coaches and contributors; `flags` are the page's own markers (its introduction counts first-year inductees older than its table does, so only the charter and centennial counts, 17 and 15, are relied on); `years` are the stint years, comma separated
rules.data_through: the end of the 2025 season (Super Bowl LX, February 8, 2026)

footer_mapping.note: read-only tables for the History screen come from this file; only the pending candidates and the league career leaders are footer seeds (nfl2k5_franchise_extension: encode_hall, encode_leaders), as j23-footer's report says
footer_mapping.seasons: season_club_line(wins, losses, ties, playoff=index of playoff_codes, division_champion=place==1, bye, place, points_for, points_against, coach=pack_person(first, last, 31), seed); season_record(year, ..., champion=arena index of `champion`, runner_up, champion_points, runner_points, awards=winners[0] of the eight kinds in SEASON_AWARDS order)
footer_mapping.records: record_entry(person, club arena index, value, year, week_row); value in the unit of the record (sacks_half in half sacks); `date` gives the game, forced_fumbles.game has no season on its page
footer_mapping.leaders: leader_entry(person, value, flags=LEADER_REAL | LEADER_LINKED when `active`, player=roster index found from `gsis_id`/`birth_date`, check); the footer takes the ten categories of LEADER_CATEGORIES, rank 1..5
footer_mapping.pending_candidates: candidate_entry(person, club arena index, retired=last_season, score=J6's rule, seasons=seasons_played, flags=HALL_REAL, keys=the `keys` in key_groups order, honors=sum of the honors counts the score uses, sb_wins=honors.super_bowl)
